The positive-definite affine case provides useful mathematical motivation, and the construction avoids computing network Jacobians.

The empirical survey is broad: 33 pretrained vision architectures evaluated over 50,000 ImageNet validation images, additional CIFAR and random-input analyses, multiple activation functions, and 17 supervised/self-supervised model variants. The empirical survey is substantial, spanning convolutional, residual, NAS-derived, transformer, and modern convolutional architectures on all 50,000 ImageNet validation images. The raw signatures and architecture comparisons reveal informative patterns beyond a single aggregate statistic.
